conventions.entityTypeIDs: entities.xml declaration order, 1-based; Account = 1. Order in the 0.6.5 file: Account, Avatar, Admin, Arena, ArenaMgr, Vehicle, Projectile, AreaDestructibles, TeamBase, ChatChannel, Registrator, OfflineEntity, SysMessenger, InviteManager, BaseAppChatManager, Clan, Node, Prebattle, InvoiceManager, AccountRenamer, VoiceChatMgr, MessageFilterManager, Flock
conventions.propertyOrder: interfaces flattened first (<Implements> document order, depth-first), then the entity's own <Properties> in document order. 'index' is the 0-based slot in that flattened list (DataDescription::index).
conventions.clientServerIndex: 0-based index among properties whose Flags have OWN_CLIENT or OTHER_CLIENT. This is the value used as the property id in entity property updates; assigned in the same flattened parse order (EntityDescription::parseProperties).
conventions.methodOrder: per direction (Client/Cell/Base): flattened interfaces' methods first in <Implements> order, then the entity's own section in document order. 'internalIndex' is the 0-based parse slot.
conventions.exposedMethodIDs: the wire method id is the EXPOSED index, not internalIndex: all ClientMethods are exposed automatically; Base/Cell methods only with <Exposed/>. Exposed ids are 0-based and assigned in the same flattened order. Entities with >62 exposed methods in a direction use BigWorld's sub-slot scheme (see exposedMethodSchemes).
conventions.unknowns: 0.6.5 defs have no <Parent> or <ClientName>, so no inheritance shifts; interface flattening order is taken from BW 2.0.1 source. The on-wire framing (which element id carries the method call, sub-slot byte) lives in the network layer, see protocol-scout.

ARRAY.wire: u16 count then items (dynamically sized array)

TUPLE.wire: fixed-size array if <size> given, items inline
